title: Utility flask
wikitext:
'''Utility flasks''' are an [[item class]] and a subtype of [[flask]]s that provides a timed bonus effect over the flask duration.

__TOC__

==Effect of stats on utility flasks==

The length of the effect can be improved by {{c|mod|x% increased Flask effect duration}} and by increasing the quality of flasks through {{il|Glassblower's Bauble}}.

The strength of the effect can be improved by {{c|mod|x% increased effect of Flasks}} [[stat]]s. Stats that are binary (i.e. enabled or disabled) will not be affected.

Binary stats are:
* Phasing
